title: StackForge
description: StackForge is a Minecraft 1.21.4 plugin that allows players to create custom item compression rules through an easy-to-use GUI. It automatically compresses items when players have the required amounts, preserves item NBT data (with an option to strip it)
body: StackForge is a powerful Minecraft 1.21.4 plugin that lets players automatically compress items in their inventory using custom rules set via an easy-to-use GUI. Players can define input and output items, set quantities, and choose whether to preserve all item NBT data—including names, lore, enchantments, and more. The plugin features clear visual feedback, anti-spam messaging, and optimized performance to enhance gameplay without hassle.
